messages:
maya: fyi the OSS HSM agent scan flagged a path traversal exploit (CVE-2026-9999). not sure if tenant payloads can reach it, opening thread for triage.
jon: can you drop the vuln link and the scanner output? we should assume high-risk. immediate steps: isolate proxy, revoke sessions, increase audit level, and plan KEK handling. @oncall please coordinate.⚠️
maya: scanner output: `CVE-2026-9999: path traversal in hsm-agent -> possible RCE when processing file upload`. details: https://vuln.example/CVE-2026-9999. ticket auto-created: INC-2026-847 by ticket-bot.
kms-bot: Automated scan result: CVE-2026-9999 (severity: high). recommended: patch agent, isolate proxy nodes, rotate session keys.
oncall: acknowledged. moving this to incident. initial checklist posted to #incident/byok-cve-9999: 1) cordon proxy nodes 2) revoke operator sessions 3) set SIEM ingest to debug for proxy namespace 4) notify legal.
sasha: for audits we'll need wrap/unwrap request events with operator identity, operator role, proxy instance id, agent binary hash, firmware id, key alias, rewrap chain id, and outcome. retention question: SOC2 requires 12 months searchable; some contracts require longer.
jon: agree. propose compact SIEM schema to avoid noise. example event (compact JSON blob):
```
{
  "event": "kms.wrap_request",
  "outcome": "succeeded",
  "operator": "alice@redwood",
  "operator_role": "hsm-operator",
  "proxy_id": "proxy-eu-12",
  "agent_hash": "sha256:abcd...",
  "firmware": "fw-2026-03-01",
  "key_alias": "cust-123/kek-v2",
  "rewrap_chain": "rw-2026-03-16-01",
  "ts": "2026-03-16T14:22:05Z",
  "reason": "agent_mismatch"
}
```
kevin: question on rotations: if we rotate the KEK for a customer, do we risk breaking pinned artifacts (models, versions) that expect the old key? we should create a cross-wrap fallback key and ensure routing can failover to hosted-safe variants if needed.
maya: ops action: create a cross-wrap key marked as emergency-fallback; legal signoff required if we re-encrypt customer-managed material.
jon: RBAC: temporarily scope rewrap permission to a 2-person quorum, require JIT approval with 1-hour TTL, require M-of-N UI approval. log both the grant and the operation. we need audit evidence for the grant event.
sasha: add more forensic data: kernel/module list and agent binary hash to every event. also capture client cert subject and relevant HTTP headers when present. export indexes per-tenant in Splunk and encrypt exports at rest with customer CMK where requested.
oncall: mitigation updates: proxies cordoned, active sessions revoked, SIEM set to debug for proxy.* namespace, incident channel active. running a dry-run rewrap on staging tenants now.
kevin: vuln triage note: test whether path traversal can be triggered via tenant-supplied objects (user uploads, model artifacts). if yes, escalate to full compromise and prepare key escrow/attestation plan. if no, patch & rewrap may suffice.
maya: legal question: @sarah-legal do we need to notify customers if we do an emergency rewrap of their BYOK material without explicit opt-in?
sarah-legal: depends on contract. if customer-managed CMK and contract permits emergency remediation we can proceed but must produce written notice and evidence. GDPR also requires documented legal basis and timely notification if confidentiality impacted. open a consent/artifact PR and keep the paper trail.
jon: add temporary mitigations to postmortem checklist: operator entitlement review, improve proof-of-possession artifacts, require firmware attestation in proxy handshake, auto-block non-attested agent binaries.
sasha: also plan to surface agent binary fingerprint in the console for customers to verify if they want.
oncall: dry-run report: ran rewrap dry-run for tenant-staging-1 and tenant-staging-2. tenant-staging-1 passed; staging-2 showed schema mismatch in audit export, fixed. no data corruption observed.
kevin: creating KEK cross-wrap key now. documenting rotation mapping: old_kek -> new_kek -> fallback_kek. will produce mapping CSV and rollback steps.
maya: please ensure we collect SOC2 evidence pack: incident timeline, audit logs, approver list, signed legal artifacts, patch timeline. we'll run a tabletop next week to review. :thumbsup:
jon: owners: rewrap plan -> @kevin, SIEM schema & ingest -> @sasha, legal notif -> @sarah-legal, incident orchestration -> @oncall. update INC-2026-847 as you complete steps.
kevin: noted. starting cross-wrap creation and mapping doc.
oncall: status update 45m: proxies still cordoned, patch build underway, dry-run ok, rolling patch to canary proxies in 30m.
maya: thanks all. keep chatter in #incident/byok-cve-9999. we'll want a detailed postmortem and audit export attached to the ticket.
